name: Seimitsu Works
description: Seimitsu Works — a theme for a precision metal parts manufacturer (CNC milling, turning, grinding and inspection), laid out as an asymmetric masonry under a formal white top header (company name, tagline, a Request a quote button and a menu button); the menu opens as a full-screen ai-nezumi blue-grey overlay with large numbered entries at every width. Ai-nezumi blue grey (#6C848D) is the main colour, textured with a fine white grid: the hero text field, the story band, the drawing-to-delivery heading block and every page head are blue-grey fields in steel-ink type. The hero puts the text on the left and a white-framed high-key photograph of the machining hall on the right, with a cut-out machined flange (transparent WebP) breaking over the frame corner, the field seam and the hero bottom edge; a cut-out turned shaft breaks over the story band and every page head. The four capabilities run as a two-column masonry of cards with photographs of different heights beside a sticky intro, and the four production steps as a staggered grid. Every picture is a realistic high-key photograph (85mm f/2.8, softbox fill, near-white background). M PLUS 1 for display, Saira for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: the plan row already asks for real-photography with the high-key direction (85mm f/2.8, large softbox fill, near-white background, very soft shadows, graded toward ai-nezumi #6C848D).
